business_summary: Henan ZhongGong Design & Research Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides engineering design consulting and survey and design services for infrastructure construction in China and internationally. The company offers comprehensive transportation planning, urban construction planning, road engineering, municipal engineering, architectural engineering, traffic engineering and logistics engineering, city traffic and underground engineering, bridge engineering, landscape and garden architecture, water transport engineering, highway maintenance, international engineering, engineering survey and investigation, engineering topography and geographical engineering, test detection, construction supervision and project management, engineering BIM, and digital image services. It is also involved in comprehensive transportation planning, urban construction planning, road engineering, municipal engineering, architectural engineering, and traffic engineering and logistics engineering projects. The company was formerly known as Henan Communications Planning & Design Institute Co., Ltd and changed its name to Henan ZhongGong Design & Research Group Co., Ltd. in June 2024. Henan ZhongGong Design & Research Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Zhengzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Henan ZhongGong Design & Research Group Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 해외 인프라 건설을 위한 엔지니어링 설계 컨설팅, 조사 및 설계 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 종합적인 교통 계획, 도시 건설 계획, 도로 엔지니어링, 도시 엔지니어링, 건축 엔지니어링, 교통 엔지니어링 및 물류 엔지니어링, 도시 교통 및 지하 엔지니어링, 교량 엔지니어링, 조경 및 정원 건축, 수운 엔지니어링, 고속도로 유지 관리, 국제 엔지니어링, 엔지니어링 조사 및 조사, 엔지니어링 지형 및 지리 엔지니어링, 테스트 감지, 건설 감독 및 프로젝트 관리, 엔지니어링 BIM 및 디지털 이미지 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 종합 교통 계획, 도시 건설 계획, 도로 엔지니어링, 도시 엔지니어링, 건축 엔지니어링, 교통 엔지니어링 및 물류 엔지니어링 프로젝트에도 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Henan Communications Planning & Design Institute Co., Ltd로 알려졌으며 2024년 6월에 Henan ZhongGong Design & Research Group Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Henan Zho
